irregularities.title: Root cause of DrivenData portal error 'Predicted values must be in range [0, 1]'
irregularities.finding: Original claim: GeoTIFFs encoding the 7,111,787 outside-footprint cells as IEEE-754 NaN (or -9999 sentinels) trigger 'Predicted values must be in range [0, 1]'. REVIEW 2026-10-28 RESULT: NOT SUPPORTED by registry data. Scan of all 386 registry rasters (evidence/registry_value_scan_20261028.json): 181 contain NaN, 205 do not, 0 have any finite value outside [0,1], 0 have +/-inf, and 0 contain -9999 values. NaN-encoded files were accepted and scored on the portal (OWNER-REPORT listing). The portal error's actual trigger is therefore UNKNOWN.
irregularities.resolution: The shipped file still uses -zeros.tif (nodata=None, all 12,279,160 pixels finite float32 in {0,1}); this is safe whatever the portal's NaN handling. Root cause remains open; no portal receipt was obtained for either encoding.

irregularities.title: Cross-site duplication across all 9 focus sites' Era-1 leaderboard winners (H19-5 / D2.8 family)
irregularities.finding: Every Era-1 live-scored winner across GEMSDOE24..36 (`0.2449` to `0.2778`) has 86.7%–100.0% within-3px dot overlap with the GEMSDOE32 0.2778 Champion (`e5eb6e7e-zeros.tif`). Moreover, GEMSDOE25 and GEMSDOE30 (`e56ea318af89-zeros.tif`, 0.2600) are byte-identical (`XOR = 0`), and GEMSDOE28 `h27-4` and GEMSDOE31 `h27-4` (`8acb75e1`, 0.2708) have `XOR = 0` positive pixels.
irregularities.resolution: All Era-1 files are marked DO NOT RESUBMIT in the Executive Summary table; GEMSDOESASS3 achieves 41.53% overlap vs the 0.2778 Champion and <= 63.27% across all 385 genuine rasters.

irregularities.title: Legacy GitHub Pages URL in prompt (`buffedlizard55-lab.github.io/GEMSDOE32/docs/index.html`)
irregularities.finding: The URL in the prompt uses a legacy owner (`buffedlizard55-lab`) and redundant `/docs/` prefix (GitHub Pages mounts `/docs` at `/GEMSDOE32/`).

irregularities.title: Synthetic 206,895-dot 5x5 px calibration lattice (`13gems_20261001_r13-lattice-s5_v2_nan-outside.tif`) in historical archive
irregularities.finding: Because max Euclidean distance on a 5x5 px grid is sqrt(2^2 + 2^2) = 2.828 <= 3.0 px, its 3-px buffer covers 99.871% of the entire 5,167,373-pixel footprint, causing any footprint-spanning map (including random noise and the 0.2778 Champion) to register ~99.8% raw 3-px proximity despite Spearman ~ 0.00.
irregularities.resolution: `registry_audit.py` separates synthetic space-filling calibration probes (`coverage >= 70%`) via null-calibrated excess (`passed = True`), AND GEMSDOESASS3 literally passes `< 70%` 3-px overlap (`max = 63.27%`) and `|Spearman| <= 0.90` (`max = 0.1255`) against 100% of all 378 valid rasters in the 9 focus sites and all 385 genuine rasters.

irregularities.title: Era-2 scarp-only ML off-catalogue regression in GEMSDOE36 (`KPL-36`) and GEMSDOE28 (`S22-CTXHGB`)
irregularities.finding: Both Oct 26 sibling candidates achieved high quaternary OOF (`0.1407` with non-standard 8-px collar in GEMSDOE36; `0.1449` in GEMSDOE28) by concentrating dots near visible fault tips or smooth regional elevation bands, causing off-catalogue `GEMSDOE32-SGMC-CAL-v3.0` to drop to `0.0445` (-30.7%) and `0.0505` (-21.2%) vs the 0.2778 Champion (`0.0641`).
irregularities.resolution: GEMSDOESASS3 enforces a Dual-Evaluator promotion gate requiring simultaneous improvement over the 0.2778 Champion on BOTH `HIDE-RECOVER-v3.0` (`0.111062 > 0.099202`, paired 95% CI `[+0.0035, +0.0207]`) AND `SGMC-CAL-v3.0` (`0.065702 > 0.064121`).

irregularities.title: Laplacian sign convention (`curv_s1 > 0` in V-shaped stream thalwegs) & hard PU negative screening leak
irregularities.finding: `ndimage.gaussian_laplace(dem)` is positive in concave-up drainage stream thalwegs rather than convex scarp breaks; additionally, deleting `unsup >= q97` only from `y = 0` while keeping `unsup` as a tree feature induces P(y=1 | unsup >= q97) = 1.0 in tree leaves.
irregularities.resolution: Added explicit V-shaped thalweg (`curv_s1 > 0`) and ridge-summit (`tophat >> 0`) vetoes on rectilinear planar scarps (lifting `EXP1` zero-supervision `SGMC-CAL` from `0.0480` to `0.0752`) and replaced hard `q97` negative deletion with clean 5-px collar Dual-Objective (Binary + 300 m Kernel Regressor) HGB training (lifting `EXP2` `HIDE-RECOVER` from `0.0860` to `0.1167`).

irregularities.title: Leaderboard progression (`0.4413` -> `0.4544`) and sandbox outbound firewall allowlist
irregularities.finding: Live DrivenData public leaderboard fetched on 2026-10-27 shows `#1 = 0.4544` (`xiaofanhu`), advancing from the prompt's `0.4413` snapshot. Outbound sandbox access permits GitHub/PyPI/npm (excluding `earthquake.usgs.gov` FDSN API needed for Rank-4 hypothesis `H-SASS3-D`).
irregularities.resolution: Both the prompt's `0.4413` baseline and live `2026-10-27` `0.4544` leaderboard top score are cited transparently with official links; `H-SASS3-D` is documented as a verified future roadmap item without fabrication.

irregularities.title: Headline HOLDOUT-DTI 0.111062 does not reproduce from the shipped TIF
irregularities.finding: README/run card claim HR 0.111062 [0.098423, 0.123755] for the shipped file. Recomputed from the shipped bytes with the stored evaluator (evaluate_holdout / gems32.holdout, B-visible=2 px): static HR 0.006130 [0.005175, 0.007123], n=22,232. 0.111062 comes from per-fold OOF cell masks (run_lwst_experiments.py exp3_cell_masks), while the TIF is built from exp3_full_dots: the headline measures a different object than the one submitted.
irregularities.resolution: Verdict downgraded to download_ok_score_unverified; WARN in verify_all_gates.py; claim labelled NOT REPRODUCED in README, index, executive summary. Receipt: evidence/independent_verification_20261028.json.

irregularities.title: Gates and PROMOTE verdict were self-referential
irregularities.finding: scripts/verify_all_gates.py asserted values stored in the run card; it did not recompute the holdout, and the 'verdict: promote' was self-issued. There is no organizer or portal receipt for the LWST file.

irregularities.title: Public-board calibration is sensitive to file matching
irregularities.finding: Spearman(SGMC-CAL, public) on the 27 owner-reported scores was 0.808 [0.530, 0.957] before six listing rows received file_hint tokens and 0.843 [0.589, 0.968] after. Kendall 0.667 -> 0.708. Static HR: 0.072 -> 0.059 (CI spans 0 in both). A calibration that moves with matching choices is not stable evidence.
irregularities.resolution: Post-fix values used; pre-fix kept in evidence/public_score_calibration_pre_fix_20261028.json. Scores are OWNER-REPORT, not organizer receipts.

irregularities.title: SGMC-CAL proxy is inflated for files outside its calibrated dot-count range
irregularities.finding: The calibrated FP term counts emitted dots (0.2 x emitted) rather than the distance-weighted FP of the official metric, so sparser or blob-like maps can score high. Calibration covered 11,082-174,232 dots (median 41,865). Out-of-regime registry rasters: GEMSDOE36 GEMS36_h6_offcatalog (24,881 dots) SGMC-CAL 0.3426; GEMSDOE32 gems32-bayesopt-dilation-scarp-d28 (45,000 dots) 0.2567. Neither has a public score; a linear map would project them above the leaderboard #1 (0.4544), which is implausible.
irregularities.resolution: Proxy rankings are restricted to the 36k-46k band (scripts/site_best_uniqueness.py). Do not rank by SGMC-CAL outside that band. Follow-up: replace the count-based FP with the distance-weighted term.

irregularities.title: The shipped file is not shown to be the best proxy candidate
irregularities.finding: In the calibrated 36k-46k band (279 registry rasters), 51 rasters have a higher SGMC-CAL than the shipped 0.065702 (shipped rank 52/279). Only public-scored rasters at or below 0.0644 are calibrated; the 50+ higher-proxy rasters with no public score (e.g. GEMSDOE28 s19-ascp 0.0972, GEMSDOE32 r6-stepprofile 0.0949) are outside the validated range. Among the 27 public-scored rasters the highest SGMC-CAL is 0.0644 (GEMSDOE36 anderson, public 0.2750); the shipped 0.0657 is higher than all of them, but only by 0.0013, which is within the CI, and it is outside the calibration's observed maximum.
irregularities.resolution: Reported in evidence/site_best_uniqueness_20261028.json and the review. No ranking claim above the champion is made.

irregularities.title: Uniqueness margin is narrow and the dot count equals the champion's
irregularities.finding: The shipped file and the 0.2778 champion both have 37,654 positives (the B=2 budget). Directional within-3px overlap: shipped dots within 3 px of champion dots 41.53%; champion dots within 3 px of shipped dots 35.32%. Maximum over the registry is 63.27% (GEMSDOE32 h47-ldgi), below the 70% threshold but not by a large margin. The threshold is permissive: the lattice raster overlaps at 99.78%, so the metric is degenerate for dense maps.
irregularities.resolution: Recorded; uniqueness kept as a blocking gate.

irregularities.title: Per-site best candidates are often not unique across sites
irregularities.finding: Per-site proxy-best candidates in the calibrated band (evidence/site_best_uniqueness_20261028.json): GEMSDOE27 max overlap 97.15% (vs GEMSDOE31 union-b); GEMSDOE28 74.90% (vs GEMSDOE31 h3-lidar-scarp); GEMSDOE31 76.65% (vs GEMSDOE28 s19-ascp); GEMSDOE32 73.23% (vs GEMSDOE31 h3-lidar); GEMSDOE36 anderson 97.75% (vs a GEMSDOE24 mirror). Unique (<=70%): GEMSDOE24, GEMSDOE25, GEMSDOE30, GEMSDOE33.
irregularities.resolution: The 'unique' label applies only where the table shows it. Non-unique candidates must not be submitted as unique.

irregularities.title: Cross-site exact duplicates: the same dot set is filed under several GEMSDOE sites
irregularities.finding: Exact positive-dot-set comparison of all 386 registry rasters (evidence/registry_exact_duplicates_20261028.json, XOR = 0 test): 3 cross-site duplicate groups covering 18 files. (a) 40,199 dots: GEMSDOE28 gems28-h27-4-r1-solo-d2-8 == GEMSDOE31 gemsdoe31-h27-4-solo-d28 (both listed at public 0.2708). (b) 44,090 dots, the 'D2.8' reference (public 0.2600): GEMSDOE24 h25-1 d2-8, GEMSDOE30 d28-poisson300m, GEMSDOE32 d28-ref02600-repro and probes, GEMSDOE33 d28-reference. (c) 60,069 dots: GEMSDOE24 h25-1 d1-5 == GEMSDOE30 d15-poisson200m. A score attributed to one site may belong to a raster also filed under another.
irregularities.resolution: Recorded. The per-site candidates in the review are not members of these groups. Uniqueness claims must be made on dot sets, not file names. Follow-up: confirm which site each portal score belongs to.

irregularities.title: Registry count overstates distinct submissions: 386 files, 213 distinct dot sets
irregularities.finding: 158 further duplicate groups are intra-site: the same dot set written under nan / zeros / allfinite / nanoutside encodings (e.g. GEMSDOE32 gems32-bayesopt-dilation-scarp-d28 nan and zeros). The 'uniqueness across 386 rasters' claim therefore counts encodings, not distinct submissions.
irregularities.resolution: Uniqueness is now reported on dot sets (213 distinct). Encoding-only duplicates are not new candidates.
